speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned a longstanding pruritic rash with numbness and tingling on your palms; how long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and have they spread to your soles?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Secondary Syphilis.

Your history of a pruritic rash on the upper body and face combined with numbness and tingling in the palms, along with your occupation involving livestock, is highly suggestive of this condition. I will request a Treponema pallidum test and please provide any images of the rash you have.
